scenes.title: Yokokawa Curtain-Screened Optical Laboratory
scenes.institution: Yokokawa Laboratory Nanometrics experimental room cB1S03
scenes.reference_notes: Official labelled lab album and two actual photographs were reviewed. Entrance-side photo shows curtains, optical workstations, computers and a doorway into a separate brighter bench area. A labelled TIRF photo shows a microscope coupled to external optics on a perforated table. Photographs establish local layout and the cB1S03 room label, not a measured footprint. The album separately shows offices, a biomechanics room and a shared cleanroom.
observed_cues: Full-height black curtains separate optical work areas.
A central rectangular doorway connects the dim entrance-side workstation area to a brighter wet-bench space.
The inverted microscope occupies one end of a broad optical table, with external cameras and separate lens mounts distributed across the remaining surface.

equipment.role: Translate a glass-slide inert target along two axes and adjust objective clearance without simulating fluorescence.
equipment.evidence: Original geometry informed by reviewed official photographs; hidden mechanics and scale estimated

scenes.title: SJTU Offshore Basin and Towing Carriage
scenes.reference_notes: Reviewed the official deepwater-basin page and two actual experiment photos. A wide interior view shows the large water basin, blue spanning steel carriage, perimeter walkway and a sloped slatted edge. The detail photo shows a small offshore platform model with tethers and floating markers in the water. A wide hall photo and model detail support the basin/overhead-carriage arrangement. Exact basin dimensions, submerged deep-well geometry and positions of pumps/control rooms remain unverified.
observed_cues: A large open water surface fills most of a high industrial hall.
A blue lattice carriage spans the basin above the water and connects its opposite sides.
A long slatted/sloping edge and perimeter access strip are visible alongside the basin, unlike a small benchtop tank.

equipment.role: Move a visible supported offshore-platform model along longitudinal carriage and transverse trolley axes. Water is a static visual proxy.
equipment.evidence: Original geometry informed by reviewed official photographs; hidden mechanics and scale estimated

support.evidence: Continuous authored support from machine frame to laboratory floor; independently inspect geometry

scenes.title: KAIST Magnetic Microscopy Probe Laboratory
scenes.institution: Ultrafast Spin Dynamics Laboratory magnetic microscopy probe station
scenes.reference_notes: Opened the official USDL site and equipment page; inspected actual installed LSMM and magnetic-field MOKE probe-station photographs. The selected MOKE station shows a Nikon LV-IM microscope over a thick perforated support platform, multiple micromanipulator probes around a central opening and a copper coil below. The LSMM image is a separate optical-workstation reference. Detailed local instrument photos, no room plan or confirmed adjacency between optical stations. Some page entries explicitly belong to or are shared with NanoSpintronics Laboratory; do not assume they are all in USDL.
observed_cues: A white microscope head hangs over a large central cut-out in a thick silver support plate.
Several independently mounted probe manipulators approach the central specimen from different sides.
A copper-wound coil sits below the specimen plane, and rigid posts carry the microscope and plate assembly.

equipment.role: Translate a visible inert semiconductor coupon in XY and adjust microscope clearance above stationary probes; field and electrical response are not modeled.
equipment.evidence: Original geometry informed by reviewed official photographs; hidden mechanics and scale estimated

scenes.title: HKUST AAF Glazed Wind Tunnel Test Section
scenes.institution: AAF large low-speed wind tunnel test section
scenes.reference_notes: Official facility page and installed hydrofoil test-section photograph reviewed. The actual photograph shows a model suspended from an overhead support, dark chamber walls, transparent side access, ceiling lamps and a floor panel. The homepage images depict CAD layouts and were explicitly excluded from real-photo evidence. Local interior view of one test section; no photographic validation of the complete return circuit or building footprint. The official page gives full test-section dimensions, but the image does not show all of that length.
observed_cues: The model is suspended centrally from a long thin overhead support, leaving open clearance below.
Dark ceiling and end-wall panels contrast with bright rectangular ceiling lamps.
Large transparent side panels provide optical access while a pale rectangular insert interrupts the darker floor.

equipment.role: Adjust yaw and pitch of a visible overhead-supported hydrofoil model inside the straight glazed test section; aerodynamic forces are absent.
equipment.evidence: Original geometry informed by reviewed official photographs; hidden mechanics and scale estimated

support.evidence: Continuous authored support from machine frame to laboratory floor; independently inspect geometry
